assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. NEW individual game sprite, a tall slender leafless beech tree, smooth pale gray trunk and fine upward forked bare branches, light snow on branch tops. Laurel Highlands frozen post-apocalyptic woodland. Input image is style/angle reference only, not edit target. Match its crisp detailed pixel-art shading, cold muted gray-brown bark, blue-white frost, front-facing slight elevated game camera, soft even lighting. Make a distinctly new silhouette. Transparent background, entire single tree including all branch tips and exposed root base fully inside canvas with 3 percent margin. No scenery, ground rectangle, text, frame or shadows extending beyond object. Isolated sprite, tightly framed, no other trees.
assets.validation: PNG RGBA; visible tree silhouette fits within canvas at alpha >128; native generated dimensions retained; faint near-transparent residual pixels outside silhouette.
